اندلقت (form VII)

# اِنْدَلَقْتَ (indalaqta) /in.da.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَلَقَ (indalaqa)
# اِنْدَلَقْتِ (indalaqti) /in.da.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَلَقَ (indalaqa)
# اِنْدَلَقَتْ (indalaqat) /in.da.la.qat/: third-person
